positive_definition: Peanut tissue occupies at least 50% of the pixel footprint.
negative_definition: No visible peanut tissue within a valid annotated pixel.

annotation_roi.definition: Pixels retained by the frozen object segmentation for the source image.
annotation_roi.outside_roi_definition: Not evaluated; never counted as a valid negative.

boundary_policy.positive_rule: Mark positive when peanut occupies at least 50% of the pixel footprint.
boundary_policy.negative_rule: Mark negative when peanut occupies less than 50% of the pixel footprint and the decision is visually reliable.
boundary_policy.ambiguous_rule: Mark ambiguous when mixing, blur, shadow, saturation or occlusion prevents a reliable binary decision.

ambiguity_policy.validity_mask: Boolean layer that is true only where the annotator made a valid binary decision.
ambiguity_policy.adjudication_rule: Resolve disagreements independently or retain the pixel as unavailable.

component_policy.meaning: Eight-connected peanut components are reference fragments.

blinding.allowed_display: Frozen source image_ref and annotation ROI only.
